### channel3d

This example examines a wall-bounded flow at high Reynolds numbers.
It features the application of wall functions in a bi-periodic, fully developed turbulent channel flow for friction Reynolds numbers of $Re_\tau=1000$ and $Re_\tau=2000$.
Results with $\OpenLB$ for a similar configuration are published e.g. in [@haussmann:19].
A visualization of the flow field is given in @fig-channel3d.
In addition, the dynamics include the RLB collision operator with a third-order equilibrium function and a Smagorinsky--Lilly turbulence model.
This example also serves as a showcase for stability improvement by hybrid recursive regularized collision schemes.
The example includes the usage of the turbulent wall model with different tunable parameters.
All parameters of the wall model are integrated into the HLBM interface.
